variants.name: baseline_rho2
variants.description: Nominal disk-excluded rho2 global fit.

variants.name: diffuse_no_loopI
variants.description: Remove both Loop I shell templates. Bubbles re-extracted self-consistently without Loop I in the background (rebuild_bubbles_per_variant.py).

variants.name: diffuse_flat_bubbles
variants.description: Replace positive/negative bubble residual templates with a single flat bubble template.

variants.name: diffuse_no_bubbles
variants.description: Remove the bubble residual templates.

variants.name: diffuse_giem
variants.description: Replace the GALPROP gas+ICS diffuse with the Fermi-LAT Galactic Interstellar Emission Model (GIEM, gll_iem_v07). Requires the prepared template mu_giem_counts.fits (and mu_giem_psf_counts.fits for the pixelwise PSF fit) in templates_dir: reproject gll_iem_v07.fits onto the ROI CAR grid and multiply by exposure. This is the cross-check against the LAT standard background that Totani (2025) also performs.

variants.name: diffuse_giem_only
variants.description: GIEM (gll_iem_v07) as the SOLE large-scale diffuse model: replaces gas+ICS AND Loop I + Fermi bubbles, since gll_iem_v07 already contains large-scale residual structures that overlap them. Diagnostic for whether the diffuse_giem halo suppression is double-counting (Loop I/bubbles fit twice) or a genuine diffuse-model effect. Compare the halo to diffuse_giem.

variants.name: mask_extended_only
variants.description: Use only the extended-source mask; do not mask bright point sources.

variants.name: mask_loose_bright
variants.description: Less aggressive bright point-source mask.

variants.name: mask_aggressive_bright
variants.description: More aggressive bright point-source mask.

variants.name: mask_energy_dependent
variants.description: Energy-dependent bright point-source mask using the LAT PSF radius scaling.

variants.name: psf_none
variants.description: Disable PSF forward-folding.

variants.name: psf_halo_only
variants.description: PSF-forward-fold only the NFW halo template.

variants.name: psf_wide_kernel
variants.description: Use the nominal PSF labels with a wider convolution truncation radius.

variants.name: mock_null_nohalo
variants.description: Fit deterministic no-halo mock counts built from the no-halo global model.

variants.name: mock_recovery_rho2
variants.description: Fit deterministic no-halo mock counts with the baseline rho2 halo injected.

variants.name: ics_morphology_flat
variants.description: Replace the nominal ICS template with a flatter-latitude ISRF variant (more inverse-Compton at high |b|), per-plane flux preserved. Tests the ISRF vertical scale-height uncertainty that competes with a smooth halo.

variants.name: ics_morphology_steep
variants.description: Replace the nominal ICS template with a steeper-latitude ISRF variant (less inverse-Compton at high |b|), per-plane flux preserved.

variants.name: roi_north
variants.description: Restrict the ROI to the northern Galactic hemisphere (b>0).

variants.name: roi_south
variants.description: Restrict the ROI to the southern Galactic hemisphere (b<0).

variants.name: mock_diffuse_ics_null
variants.description: Fit the diffuse-mismodelling mock: no-halo truth with a distorted ICS morphology and no injected halo. Spurious-halo null test.

variants.name: quad_NE_excl
variants.description: NE quadrant (hemisphere=north, lon=east), disk excluded.

variants.name: quad_NE_incl
variants.description: NE quadrant (hemisphere=north, lon=east), disk included.

variants.name: quad_NW_excl
variants.description: NW quadrant (hemisphere=north, lon=west), disk excluded.

variants.name: quad_NW_incl
variants.description: NW quadrant (hemisphere=north, lon=west), disk included.

variants.name: quad_SE_excl
variants.description: SE quadrant (hemisphere=south, lon=east), disk excluded.

variants.name: quad_SE_incl
variants.description: SE quadrant (hemisphere=south, lon=east), disk included.

variants.name: quad_SW_excl
variants.description: SW quadrant (hemisphere=south, lon=west), disk excluded.

variants.name: quad_SW_incl
variants.description: SW quadrant (hemisphere=south, lon=west), disk included.

variants.name: iem_sl_z6
variants.description: GALPROP IEM model grid (Ackermann et al. 2012, ApJ 750, 3), model 'SL_Z6_R30_T150_C2'. Replaces the baseline gas+ICS diffuse pair with this model's own gas_iem_sl_z6/ics_iem_sl_z6 templates; every other template unchanged. ANCHOR / VALIDATION model: identified with the existing analysis baseline GALDEF (Lorimer pulsar cosmic-ray sources, z_h=6 kpc, R=30 kpc halo radius, T_S=150 K HI spin temperature, E(B-V) cut 2 mag). Included as a consistency check -- its fit is expected to closely match baseline_rho2 -- NOT an independent excursion; exclude it when computing the systematic spread over this group.
